text: Reframe the accessibility-transcript idea from "the loop's eye for UX quality" to a narrow source-level state-existence + semantic-structure audit, and test whether this repo's client/data-coupled components render to a stable transcript at all before relying on it.

Prove a PERCEPTUAL verdict's citation actually supports rather than merely accompanies its claim: bind perceptual ADVANCE to a checkable mechanical proxy or force explicit abstention, and measure the non-supporting-citation rate before trusting the gate.

Do not treat the root PNGs as an oracle unless a committed manifest first pins each screenshot to a live route and records verified capture provenance and date, discarding any fossil older than the source it claims to bless.

Do not rely on pre-registered acceptance criteria alone to keep a design/review gate honest; externalise the gate to a separate persona/turn with no authorship memory, or to a signal the proposer cannot author.

Never treat an LLM's inability to name a screen's purpose from a stripped serialization as evidence of human discoverability failure; if the probe is kept, restrict it to the correlation-free reachability check.
Size a scout cycle at roughly 650k rather than 350k tokens (alpha averaged ~30k and beta ~55k per subagent against budgeted 5.5k/30k), or reduce N and M to fit the stated budget.
Enforce the LOOP.md 5.2 word cap mechanically at schema-validation time or raise it; all 10 alpha idea-docs overran 600 words (877-1485 actual), so the cap as written is advisory only.
